item.tib: tshe dbang gsang ba yang zhun las char 'beb rgya mtsho mer ba
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar mas nges med sprang po drung mu wer ro la/ gyim shod shel brag tu/ dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes bco lnga la snyan du brgyud/ mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa dang / dad ldan grogs pos bskul ba'i ngor/ zab mo dben pa'i ri khrod du/ dkar chag yi ger bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog bon 'di dar rgyas nyi ma'i zer bzhin shog/
